# Room agent logos — provenance

Marks used only to identify the five fixed Local Room seats in the Agents
grid. Nominative use — each mark identifies its own upstream project (or the
Bony platform for DocSmith, which has no third-party brand).

| File | Upstream | License / policy | Source | Modifications |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grok.svg` | [xAI Grok brand guidelines](https://x.ai/legal/brand-guidelines) | Marks may be used to accurately refer to xAI services; logos must be used exactly as provided | Same asset as `public/harness-logos/grok.svg` (`Grok_Logomark_Dark.svg`) | None |
| `zeroclaw.png` | [zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw](https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw) | MIT OR Apache-2.0; name/logo are trademarks — nominative identification of the ZeroClaw harness only | `web/public/logo.png` | None |
| `unity.svg` | [simple-icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) (slug `unity`) | CC0-1.0 path data; nominative use of the Unity mark | `icons/unity.svg` | Placed on a white rounded square so the black mark stays legible in dark UI |
| `openmontage.svg` | [calesthio/OpenMontage](https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage) | Upstream project asset (Monty the Clapper mascot) | `assets/monty-dark.svg` | None (dark-theme variant) |
| `docsmith.png` | Bony Desktop | Bony product mark | `public/app-icon@2x.png` | None — DocSmith is a Bony room seat with no separate upstream brand logo |
